title: 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA: the ladder below the factory, and how it refuels
text: Law B was an artefact of a run stored in pieces (gone once they are merged; the same bound). The hits the factory passes on are counted in base 4 by a ladder of blocks (10)<sup>R</sup>, and when the factory's fuel runs out the ladder's top block becomes its next fuel, [100]<sup>2⌊(R<sub>0</sub>−1)/3⌋−4</sup>, while the ladder moves up by one block. Checked on the digit recursion; a level skip that runs this flow as arithmetic is next.
